name: Warrior
resourceDesc: Vigor builds from landed Strikes, blows taken and well-timed Guards and is spent on Challenge, Guard and weapon techniques; DPS builds also stack weapon pressure (0-5) from Strikes to spend on finishers.
identity: A flexible frontline weapon fighter who reads enemy swings and decides, moment to moment, whether Vigor becomes a block, a finisher or a rally for the group.

branches.name: Tank
branches.loop: Spend vigor on blocks, intercepts and threat; time Guard against enemy swings instead of holding it.
branches.tradeoff: Reduced offensive spending: Vigor committed to Guard and Challenge is not available for weapon techniques.

nodes.name: Hardened Grip
nodes.desc: Blows you absorb with Guard generate +1 Vigor per rank, so a well-held line funds its own next block.

nodes.name: Tempered Armor
nodes.desc: +8 armor per rank. Reduces incoming weapon damage.

nodes.name: Timed Guard
nodes.desc: An enemy blow landing within 0.5s of you raising Guard is a timed Guard and refunds 3 Vigor per rank. Watch the enemy swing timer on the target frame.

nodes.name: Scarred Veteran
nodes.desc: +3% maximum health per rank.

nodes.name: Steady Challenge
nodes.desc: Challenge refunds 10 Vigor when it lands, making taunts self-funding during pulls.

nodes.name: Intercept
nodes.desc: New action: dash to Mira (up to 10m) and take the next enemy blow aimed at her within 3s at Guard strength. 20 Vigor, 15s cooldown.

nodes.name: Bulwark
nodes.desc: Guard lasts 7s and reduces incoming damage by 75% instead of 60%.

nodes.name: Long Reach
nodes.desc: Intercept range +4m per rank; the enemy whose blow you intercept is Challenged for 2s per rank.

nodes.name: Grudge Ledger
nodes.desc: Enemies you have Challenged in the last 10s deal 2% less damage to you per rank.

nodes.name: Held Line
nodes.desc: While Guard is up, each blow you take gives 3 more Vigor and 50 threat.

nodes.name: Iron Reserve
nodes.desc: In a fight below half health, you regain 2 Vigor a second per rank.

nodes.name: Unbroken Line
nodes.desc: Each timed Guard during Held Line lowers its drain by 1 Vigor/s per rank for 5s (stacks up to 3 times).

nodes.name: Rebuke
nodes.desc: Timed Guards return 10% of the blocked damage per rank to the attacker as high-threat damage.

nodes.name: Stand Fast
nodes.desc: A hit that would drop you below 20% health instead triggers a free 3s Guard. 90s cooldown, reduced 20s per rank.

nodes.name: Forgespire Plating
nodes.desc: Guard also reduces periodic and spell damage at 20% of its normal strength per rank.

nodes.name: Mountain's Keel
nodes.desc: While Held Line is up, Challenge becomes an 8m area taunt and allies within 8m take 15% less damage from Challenged enemies. Held Line's drain rises to 6 Vigor/s.

branches.name: DPS
branches.loop: Build weapon pressure with Strikes and spend it during exposed-target windows opened by whiffed or Guarded enemy attacks.
branches.tradeoff: Fewer defensive responses: Guard and Challenge compete with finishers for Vigor, and deep damage talents weaken Guard.

nodes.name: Edge Discipline
nodes.desc: Automatic swings have a 5% chance per rank to add 1 weapon pressure.

nodes.name: Heavy Hand
nodes.desc: +2 weapon damage per rank, including automatic swings.

nodes.name: Read the Opening
nodes.desc: Exposed windows last 0.5s longer per rank. Enemies are Exposed for 3s when your Guard absorbs their blow; Exposed enemies take 5% more damage from your party.

nodes.name: Honed Edge
nodes.desc: Strike deals +4% damage per rank against Exposed targets.

nodes.name: Finishing Strike
nodes.desc: Strike deals +8 damage against targets below 40% health.

nodes.name: Breaching Blow
nodes.desc: New action: spend all weapon pressure (Strike builds 1, max 5) on a blow dealing 12 damage per pressure that Exposes the target for 4s. 10s cooldown.

nodes.name: Sweeping Strike
nodes.desc: Strike also deals half its raw damage to other enemies within 4m of its target. Can pull extra enemies.

nodes.name: Deep Breach
nodes.desc: Breaching Blow at 5 pressure staggers the target, delaying its next swing by 0.5s per rank.

nodes.name: Gathering Swing
nodes.desc: Each weapon pressure held raises attack speed by 1% per rank.

nodes.name: Press the Breach
nodes.desc: For 6 seconds after Breaching Blow, Strike costs no Vigor and builds 2 pressure.

nodes.name: Battle Rhythm
nodes.desc: A Breaching Blow that spends 5 pressure restores 4 Vigor per rank.

nodes.name: Relentless Press
nodes.desc: If a finisher kills during Press the Breach, it lasts 1s longer per rank and carries to the nearest enemy, Exposing it.

nodes.name: Reckless Stance
nodes.desc: +5% damage per rank, but Guard reduces 10% less damage per rank.

nodes.name: Greatweapon Arc
nodes.desc: Two-handed grip: Sweeping Strike hits a wide 150-degree arc and deals +10% per rank, but Strike recovers 0.1s slower per rank.

nodes.name: Paired Blades
nodes.desc: Dual grip: automatic swings strike twice at 55% damage, and each second hit has a 10% chance per rank to add 1 weapon pressure.

nodes.name: Forgefall
nodes.desc: Breaching Blow at 5 pressure becomes Forgefall: a leaping blow dealing triple damage to the Exposed target and half to nearby foes. You cannot Guard for 4s afterward.

branches.name: Support
branches.loop: Rally allies and expose enemies; intercept at the right moment so a teammate's worst hit lands on you instead.
branches.tradeoff: Personal damage funds party gains: rally effects cost Vigor and deep nodes lower your own Strike output.

nodes.name: Called Cadence
nodes.desc: Challenge rallies you for 6s: +4% attack speed per rank. Mira, if within 10m, casts and recovers 4% faster per rank for the same 6s.

nodes.name: Rally Reserve
nodes.desc: +10 maximum Vigor per rank. More capacity, not faster regeneration.

nodes.name: Mark the Gap
nodes.desc: Strike Exposes its target for 1s per rank (Exposed enemies take 5% more damage from your party).

nodes.name: Steady Voice
nodes.desc: Your rally effects (Rallying Challenge, Called Cadence, Muster, Shared Shelter, Planted Standard) reach 2m further per rank.

nodes.name: Rallying Challenge
nodes.desc: Challenge restores 12 mana to Mira when she is recruited, alive and within 13m.

nodes.name: Muster
nodes.desc: New action: spend 25 Vigor to give you and Mira (within 12m) a 20-point barrier for 6s. 30s cooldown.

nodes.name: Shared Shelter
nodes.desc: Guard also heals Mira for 20 and reduces her incoming damage by 30% for 5s. Requires 13m range.

nodes.name: Planted Standard
nodes.desc: Muster plants a standard for 4s per rank; you and Mira regain 2 Vigor or mana per second within 8m of it.

nodes.name: Scatter Their Guard
nodes.desc: Exposed enemies take a further 3% damage per rank from your party.

nodes.name: Answering Step
nodes.desc: A blow you Intercept Exposes its attacker to your party for 5 seconds.

nodes.name: Shared Second Wind
nodes.desc: Muster restores 3 Vigor per rank, twice that when it reaches Mira too.

nodes.name: Shoulder to Shoulder
nodes.desc: The ally saved by Answering Step takes 5% less damage per rank for 6s; if they survive, its cooldown drops 2s per rank.

nodes.name: Drilled Formation
nodes.desc: Allies within 8m of you take 2% less damage per rank from enemies you have Challenged.

nodes.name: Lend the Edge
nodes.desc: Your Strike deals 5% less damage per rank; that amount is added to the next ally attack on the same target.

nodes.name: Weathered Voice
nodes.desc: Muster's barriers absorb 10% more per rank and also remove one slowing effect.

nodes.name: Stormlight Standard
nodes.desc: Answering Step also plants your standard: for 8s allies within 10m share 20% of incoming damage with you and receive your Vigor refunds as their resource. Your damage is halved meanwhile.
